New BIS quality rules for phone screen protectors from April 1

The Indian government has mandated new Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) quality rules for smartphone screen protectors, which will be effective from April 1. This move aims to prevent the sale of substandard products and promote domestic manufacturing.
